title: 第13章 狗急跳墙的昊天第14章 区区金仙而已袁福通何在
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第13章狗急跳墙的昊天！“大王，您真的不杀我等？”
直到袁福通被人松绑，拿起那套阵旗后，依旧有些难以置信地看着帝辛。
自己可是造反啊！
不诛连九族已经是天大的恩赐了，竟然连自己这些魁首都不杀，
还让自己守朝歌、守宫门？
别说他们，就连闻仲也都露出难以置信的表情，同时不断地上下打量帝辛！
变了，
真的变了！
这时候的闻仲，当真是老怀欣慰啊！
这才是人皇该有的胸襟！
而听到袁福通的话后，帝辛却平静地看着他们：“孤王要用你们的余生，让你们知道，造孤王的反，是你们这辈子最最愚蠢的选择，下去吧，这些人如何分配由袁福通安排，之后通报比干即可！”
袁福通等人心悦诚服道：“是，大王！”
随着袁福通等人离开，早朝也很快就散去了，帝辛则赶回御书房，准备吸收那万年修为突破到金仙。
此时，
朝会上发生的一切，以极快的速度传遍朝歌，同时经由‘风雨司’，传到了四海，传到了每个龙王庙的庙祝耳中。
“你听说了吗？北海七十二路诸侯造反，袁福通等人被生擒，大王非但没有杀他们，还让他们守朝歌，将功赎罪！”
“可不是，我还听说大王亲口说，袁福通等人造反，根源在大王，甚至大王把北海范围，人们吃不饱、穿不暖的罪过，都归咎到自己身上了！”
“你还不知道吧，大王让袁福通戴罪立功的事情传回了北海，据说北海那边要给大王立生祠，却被大王制止了！”
“对对对……这件事我听说了，大王说：立龙王庙可保风调雨顺，给孤王立生祠，只会劳民伤财，所以现在北海不立生祠了，都该拜大王的长生位了！”
……

短短三天的时间，这件事几乎已经到了人尽皆知的地步，特别是帝辛将北海罪过，全都揽到自己身上的事情，更是引起了无数人的讨论。
这时候，
有一名来自北海的龙子忍不住了，直接跳了出来——
“人族人皇何错之有，却要承受这无妄之灾，之前南方水灾，北方大旱，实际上是天庭的命令，人族人皇不应该为天庭背锅！”
轰！
此言一出洪荒万民震动，
紧接着，
东海、西海、南海分别有龙子跳了出来，将之前各地旱涝的真实原因，经由庙祝之口传开。
一时间，
洪荒万民震动，齐声高呼‘大王大德’，转过身又愤怒指天，怒骂昊天无德！
随后洪荒人道大震，万民归心下，人道之力疯狂暴涨，人族气运也在飞速增加，气运汇聚朝歌，大商国运又增加了十年！
可除天地间的圣人外，却没人能看到这一幕！
天外，
女娲宫！
察觉到殷商气运暴涨，之前帝辛联合龙族时，消耗的三分之一的人族气运，也在瞬间暴涨了回来，甚至还在暴涨时，
女娲酸了！
如果不是被帝辛斩了因果，这时候她的力量应该暴涨才对！
想到这，
女娲更是气不打一处来，意识直接降临到轩辕坟——
content_en:
Chapter 13 Haotian jumps over the wall in a hurry! "Your Majesty, are you really not going to kill us?"
Until Yuan Futong was released and picked up the set of formation flags, he still looked at Di Xin in disbelief.
You are rebelling!
Not killing the nine tribes is already a great gift, but not even leaders like myself are killed.
And let yourself guard Chaoge and guard the palace gate?
Not to mention them, even Wen Zhong showed an expression of disbelief and kept looking at Di Xin up and down!
changed,
Really changed!
At this time, Wen Zhong was really happy!
This is the magnanimity that a human emperor should have!
After hearing Yuan Futong's words, Di Xin looked at them calmly: "King Gu will spend the rest of your life to let you know that rebelling against King Gu is the stupidest choice in your life. Go down. The distribution of these people will be arranged by Yuan Futong, and then just inform Bigan!"
Yuan Futong and others were convinced: "Yes, Your Majesty!"
As Yuan Futong and others left, the morning court quickly dispersed, and Di Xin rushed back to the Imperial Study Room, preparing to absorb the ten thousand-year cultivation base to break through to the Golden Immortal.
At this time,
Everything that happened in the court meeting was spread throughout the court at an extremely fast speed. At the same time, it was spread all over the world through the "Fengyu Division" and reached the ears of every temple minister in the Dragon King Temple.
"Have you heard? The seventy-two princes in Beihai rebelled, and Yuan Futong and others were captured alive. Instead of killing them, the king asked them to observe the court song and atone for their sins!"
"No, I also heard that the king himself said that the rebellion of Yuan Futong and others was caused by the king. The king even blamed himself for the lack of food and clothing for people in the Beihai area!"
"You still don't know, but the news that the king asked Yuan Futong to serve his crime has spread back to Beihai. It is said that there is a shrine to be built in Beihai for the king, but the king stopped him!"
"Yes, yes...I heard about this. The king said: erecting the Dragon King Temple will ensure good weather, but erecting a living temple for the lonely king will only waste people and money. So now that there is no living shrine in Beihai, it is time for everyone to worship the king for his immortality!"
…
In just three days, this matter has almost become known to everyone, especially the fact that Di Xin took all the blame of Beihai on himself, which aroused countless people's discussion.
At this time,
There was a dragon from Beihai who couldn't bear it anymore and jumped out——
"Why did the Human Emperor do anything wrong, yet he has to endure such unreasonable disasters? The previous floods in the south and severe drought in the north were actually orders from Heaven. The Human Emperor should not take the blame for Heaven!"
Boom!
As soon as these words came out, all the people were shocked.
Immediately afterwards,
Dragon sons jumped out from the East China Sea, the West China Sea, and the South China Sea respectively, and spread the true causes of droughts and floods in various places through the mouth of Miao Zhu.
for a time,
The people of the ancient world were shocked and shouted in unison, "Great King, Great Virtue". Then they turned around and pointed angrily at the sky, scolding Haotian for his lack of virtue!
Then there was a great earthquake in the ancient world, and all the people returned to their hearts. The power of humanity surged wildly, and the luck of the human race also increased rapidly. The luck gathered in Chaoge, and the fortune of the Great Shang Dynasty increased by another ten years!
But except for the saints in heaven and earth, no one can see this scene!
Beyond the sky,
Nuwa Palace!
Realizing that the Yin Shang's luck had skyrocketed, one-third of the human luck that Di Xin had consumed when he united with the Dragon Clan had surged back in an instant. Even while it was still skyrocketing,
Nuwa is sour!
If she hadn't been killed by Di Xin, her power would have skyrocketed at this time!
Thinking of this,
Nuwa was even more furious, and her consciousness came directly to Xuanyuan Tomb——
